content: Professional backtesting tools distinguish winning from losing trades via entry-time metrics: (1) Technical confluence at key levels (MA, Fibonacci, support); (2) Pullback entry timing — 50% Fib retracement or 21 EMA with confirming candle; (3) Breakout volume quality — at least 1.5x average body size for engulfing candles. Core metrics for W/L discrimination: Expectancy (avg R per trade), Win Rate vs Risk-Reward ratio (40% win rate + 3:1 RR beats 60% win + 0.5:1), Profit Factor (gross profit / gross loss, >1.0 required). Entry quality assessed via MAE/MFE distribution: clean losses vs given-back winners. Tools like TradeZella track MAE/MFE per trade. If losing trades first reach 1.5-2.0R MFE before reversing, a trailing stop or earlier exit converts them. Winner characteristics: minimal MAE, fast MFE. Loser characteristics: immediate adverse excursion, slow MFE.
